question: Should the Auto QA playbook require these stronger clean-checkout, independently observed worker, and live-output evidence gates for future campaigns?
rationale: This is an internal operating-policy change: syntax validation cannot determine whether the added gates strike the intended balance between evidence quality and campaign usability.

options.title: Accept the stricter evidence gates

options.title: Narrow the guidance
options.body: Revise any guard that maintainers consider too rigid before merging so campaigns retain a workable documented fallback.
